.hero-bio.en: Four years of freelance experience with international clients across LA, Paris, Duisburg, and Berlin, paired with local market knowledge in Bosnia and Herzegovina. I specialize in e-commerce websites with SEO at the foundation—building systems that drive real business outcomes.
.hero-bio.bs: Četiri godine iskstva frilensera s međunarodnim klijentima iz Los Angelesa, Pariza, Duisburga i Berlina, uz duboko poznavanje lokalnog tržišta u Bosni i Hercegovini. Specijaliziran sam za e-commerce web stranice sa SEO-om kao temeljem—gradim sisteme koji donose stvarne poslovne rezultate.

.sub-message-text.en: If you think I can help you build something, or if you just want to meet, drop me an email.
.sub-message-text.bs: Ako mislite da vam mogu pomoći da nešto izgradite, ili ako se samo želite upoznati, pošaljite mi e-mail.

#product .section-title.en: STEM Pionir: Robotics for the Next Generation
#product .section-title.bs: STEM Pionir: Robotika za sljedeću generaciju

#product .section-desc.en: Designing and manufacturing Bosnia's first screen-free STEM toy. This was a platform built from the ground up, requiring a fusion of mechanical engineering, electronic design, and pedagogical strategy.
#product .section-desc.bs: Dizajniranje i proizvodnja prve bosanske STEM igračke bez ekrana. Ovo je bila platforma izgrađena od nule, koja je zahtijevala spoj mašinskog inženjeringa, dizajna elektronike i pedagoške strategije.

#tea-recipe .showcase-title-area .ps-con.en: Custom WordPress Tool for Production Operations
#tea-recipe .showcase-title-area .ps-con.bs: Prilagođeni WordPress alat za proizvodne operacije

#tea-recipe > p.ps-content.en: A specialized internal system designed to bridge the gap between production recipes and real-time inventory costs. It automates financial tracking for tea blends while providing employees with a digital logging interface for food safety compliance.
#tea-recipe > p.ps-content.bs: Specijalizirani interni sistem dizajniran da premosti jaz između recepata za proizvodnju i troškova zaliha u realnom vremenu. Automatizuje finansijsko praćenje mješavina čaja uz pružanje zaposlenicima digitalnog interfejsa za prijavu u skladu sa sigurnošću hrane.

#siegmann-ai .framework-title.bs: 🖼️ SiegmannStock AI Vision i cjevovod za automatsko određivanje cijena

#siegmann-ai .showcase-title-area .ps-co.en: Production AI Asset Enrichment for WooCommerce
#siegmann-ai .showcase-title-area .ps-co.bs: Proizvodno obogaćivanje AI imovine za WooCommerce

#siegmann-ai > p.ps-content.en: Automated suite that classifies, scores, and prices stock photography at scale using multi-modal AI. Replaced manual categorization with a rule-based scoring engine that evaluates images across conceptual, commercial, and technical axes.
#siegmann-ai > p.ps-content.bs: Automatizovani paket koji klasifikuje, ocenjuje i određuje cene stock fotografija u velikom obimu koristeći multimodalni AI. Zamenjena ručna kategorizacija mehanizmom za bodovanje zasnovanim na pravilima koji procjenjuje slike kroz konceptualne, komercijalne i tehničke ose.

#sublimoss .showcase-title-area .ps-cont.en: Brand Build & Conversion Strategy for French Wellness Market
#sublimoss .showcase-title-area .ps-cont.bs: Izgradnja brenda i strategija konverzije za francusko wellness tržište

#sublimoss > p.ps-content.en: End-to-end page architecture for a French sea moss brand. Translated complex nutritional specs into high-conversion narratives using psychological clustering and lean design principles.
#sublimoss > p.ps-content.bs: Arhitektura stranice od kraja do kraja za francuski brend morske mahovine. Prevedene složene nutritivne specifikacije u narative visoke konverzije koristeći psihološko klasterisanje i principe lean dizajna.

#rawear-crm .framework-title.bs: 💼 B2B RAWEAR: CRM za prodajnu inteligenciju

#rawear-crm .showcase-title-area .ps-con.en: Behavioral Psychology + AI-Powered B2B Outreach System
#rawear-crm .showcase-title-area .ps-con.bs: Bihevioralna psihologija + B2B sistem dohvata vođen AI-om

#rawear-crm > p.ps-content.en: Full-Stack CRM combining behavioral psychology with AI-powered sales intelligence for hyper-personalized B2B outreach. Analyzes fear patterns, identifies cognitive hooks, and maps behavioral signals to optimal sales strategies.
#rawear-crm > p.ps-content.bs: Full-Stack CRM koji kombinuje bihevioralnu psihologiju sa prodajnom inteligencijom na bazi AI-a za hiper-personalizovan B2B doseg. Analizira obrasce straha, identifikuje kognitivne kuke i mapira bihevioralne signale do optimalnih prodajnih strategija.

#content-pipeline > p.ps-content.en: Production infrastructure that transforms content production into a compounding data asset. Captures psychological intelligence that generic AI cannot synthesize and competitors cannot buy.
#content-pipeline > p.ps-content.bs: Proizvodna infrastruktura koja transformiše proizvodnju sadržaja u podatkovnu imovinu koja se akumulira. Bilježi psihološku inteligenciju koju generički AI ne može sintetizirati i koju konkurenti ne mogu kupiti.

#semantic-search .showcase-title-area .p.en: AI-Powered Vector Search with Intent Parsing
#semantic-search .showcase-title-area .p.bs: Vektorska pretraga vođena AI-om sa analizom namjere

#semantic-search > p.ps-content.en: Custom plugin replacing keyword search with semantic vector search. Uses AI embeddings to match queries based on meaning, mood, and emotional intent rather than literal keywords.
#semantic-search > p.ps-content.bs: Prilagođeni dodatak koji zamjenjuje pretragu ključnih riječi semantičkom vektorskom pretragom. Koristi AI ugradnje za podudaranje upita na osnovu značenja, raspoloženja i emocionalne namjere umjesto doslovnih ključnih riječi.

#stem-toy-technical .star-content:nth-ch.en: Educational robotics kits were either plastic-heavy toys with low durability or complex systems requiring screens and immediate coding knowledge, creating high barriers to entry.
#stem-toy-technical .star-content:nth-ch.bs: Edukativni robotiki setovi su bili ili igračke od plastike sa niskom trajnošću ili složeni sistemi koji zahtijevaju ekrane i trenutno poznavanje kodiranja, što je stvaralo visoke prepreke za ulazak.

#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.en: Develop a modular, durable, and screen-free robotics kit that teaches fundamental mechanics and electronics to children aged 7-15.
#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.bs: Razviti modularan, trajan i robotiki set bez ekrana koji uči osnovne mehanike i elektroniku djeci uzrasta 7-15 godina.

#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.en: Engineered a modular wooden construction system using real mechanical fasteners. Designed basic electronic circuits with DC motors to teach physics principles without software complexity.
#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.bs: Projektovao modularni drveni konstrukcijski sistem koristeći prave mehaničke spojnice. Dizajnirao osnovna elektronska kola sa DC motorima za učenje principa fizike bez softverske kompleksnosti.

#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.en: Successfully launched a sustainable learning platform used in 15+ schools, improving spatial intelligence and mechanical debugging skills in thousands of children.
#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.bs: Uspješno lansirao održivu platformu za učenje korištenu u 15+ škola, poboljšavajući prostornu inteligenciju i mehaničke vještine otklanjanja grešaka u hiljadama djece.

#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(1).en: Most STEM toys follow a "build once" manual. Once the model is complete, the learning stops, and the toy is abandoned, offering no long-term engagement or creative freedom.
#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(1).bs: Većina STEM igračaka prati "izgradi jednom" priručnik. Jednom kada je model završen, učenje staje, a igračka se napušta, ne nudeći dugoročnu angažovanost ili kreativnu slobodu.

#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(2).en: Designed the STEM Pionir as a constructionist toolset. The same components build drawing robots, catapults, or vehicles. Shifting focus from "What to build" to "How mechanics work," fostering a growth mindset.
#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(2).bs: Dizajnirao STEM Pionir kao konstruktivistički alat. Isti komponente grade robote za crtanje, katapulte ili vozila. Pomicanje fokisa sa "Šta izgraditi" na "Kako mehanika radi," razvijajući mentalitet rasta.

#webdev .section-desc.en: Building production WordPress plugins, AI-powered search systems, and semantic SEO infrastructure. My focus is on scalable e-commerce architectures, API integrations, and tools that reduce operational overhead.
#webdev .section-desc.bs: Izrada produkcijskih WordPress dodataka, sistema pretrage na bazi AI i semantičke SEO infrastrukture. Moj fokus je na skalabilnim e-commerce arhitekturama, API integracijama i alatima koji smanjuju operativne troškove.

.about-intro.en: I specialize in building and scaling e-commerce websites with SEO at the foundation—not as an afterthought, but as the core architecture. I spent the last decade founding, building, and scaling products, bringing that founder's ownership mindset to high-performance engineering teams.
.about-intro.bs: Specijaliziran sam za izgradnju i skaliranje e-commerce web stranica sa SEO-om kao temeljem—ne kao naknadna misao, već kao osnovna arhitektura. Prošlu deceniju proveo sam osnivajući, gradeći i skalirajući proizvode, donoseći mentalitet vlasništva osnivača visoko-performantnim inženjerskim timovima.

.about-differentiator .about-text.en: I don't just execute features—I've lived with the consequences of bad technical decisions. I've managed technical debt as a founder managing real customer impact, not as a developer inheriting someone else's problems.
.about-differentiator .about-text.bs: Ne samo izvršavam funkcije—živio sam sa posljedicama loših tehničkih odluka. Upravljao sam tehničkim dugom kao osnivač koji upravlja stvarnim uticajem na kupce, a ne kao programer koji nasljeđuje tuđe probleme.

.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.en: It started with taking things apart. As a kid, I dismantled every toy I owned to understand what was inside. When my father rigged a sewing machine motor to generate electricity during power outages during the war, something clicked. I needed to know how systems worked—from the inside out.
.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.bs: Počelo je rastavljanjem stvari. Kao dijete, rastavio sam svaku igračku koju sam imao da bih razumijeo šta je unutra. Kad je otac prilagodio motor za šivenje da generiše struju za vrijeme nestanka struje tokom rata, nešto se kliknulo. Morao sam znati kako sistemi rade—iznutra navan.

.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.en: That curiosity never left. I launched Bosnia's first STEM toy product, led youth organizations, and built e-commerce platforms. Each experience taught me the same lesson: technical skill without business context is just clever engineering that doesn't matter.
.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.bs: Ta radoznalost nikada nije napustila. Lansirao sam prvi bosanski STEM proizvod, vodio omladinske organizacije i gradio e-commerce platforme. Svako iskustvo naučilo mi je istu lekciju: tehnička vještina bez poslovnog konteksta je samo pametno inženjering koji nema važnosti.

.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(2.en: I value autonomy, ownership, and direct communication. Running organizations taught me that the best work happens when you understand the business behind the code. I don't just build features—I ask what problem we're actually solving and for whom.
.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(2.bs: Cijenim autonomiju, vlasništvo i direktnu komunikaciju. Vođenje organizacija naučilo me da se najbolji rad događa kada razumijete biznis iza koda. Ne samo gradim funkcije—pitam se koji problem zapravo rješavamo i za koga.

.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(3.en: I prefer autonomy over hand-holding, but I ask questions instead of making assumptions. Technical decisions should be guided by business impact, not technical convenience.
.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(3.bs: Preferiram autonomiju umjesto držanja za ruku, ali postavljam pitanja umjesto da pravim pretpostavke. Tehničke odluke bi trebale biti vođene poslovnim uticajem, a ne tehničkom pogodnošću.

.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(2).en: When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring how search psychology influences buying decisions or researching why certain products succeed while others fail. I'm obsessed with understanding what happens in that moment before someone clicks—the thinking they don't yet know they're doing.
.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(2).bs: Kad ne kodiram, pronaći ćete me kako istražujem kako psihologija pretrage utiče na odluke o kupovini ili istražujem zašto određeni proizvodi uspijevaju dok drugi ne uspijevaju. Opsednut sam razumijevanjem šta se dešava u tom trenutku prije nego neko klikne—mišljenje koje još uvijek ne znaju da rade.

.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(3).en: I also mentor young entrepreneurs and speak at youth leadership programs. Passing forward what I've learned matters as much as building things.
.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(3).bs: Takođe mentorujem mlade poduzetnike i govorim na programima omladinskog vođstva. Proslijeđivanje onoga što sam naučio jednako je važno kao i gradeći stvari.

.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(4).en: Currently based in Sarajevo, open to opportunities where I can bring both technical depth and business awareness to meaningful work.
.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(4).bs: Trenutno baziran u Sarajevu, otvoren za prilike gdje mogu donijeti i tehničku dubinu i poslovnu svijest značajnom radu.

#seo .section-desc.en: Search Is About Decisions, Not Keywords.
#seo .section-desc.bs: Pretraga je o odlukama, ne ključnim riječima.

#seo-problem .framework-title.en: The Problem: Random Content Creates Random Results
#seo-problem .framework-title.bs: Problem: Nasumični sadržaj stvara nasumične rezultate

#seo-problem .ps-content.en: Traditional SEO teaches you to chase individual terms. Write for keywords. Build links. Hope. That approach treats search engines like slot machines — when the real engine is an LLM reading your site the same way a human analyst reads a document. It follows structure. It verifies facts. It remembers consistency.
#seo-problem .ps-content.bs: Tradicionalni SEO teči da juriš pojedinačne terme. Piši za ključne riječi. Gradi linkove. Nadaš. Taj pristup tretira pretraživače kao apariate za sreću — kada je pravi motor LLM koji čita vaš sajt na isti način kao što ljudski analitičar čita dokument. Prati strukturu. Provjerava činjenice. Pamti konzistentnost.

.comparison-wrong .comparison-text.en: Keywords placed by chance, blog posts published in bursts, competitors outranking with thinner content
.comparison-wrong .comparison-text.bs: Ključne riječi postavljene slučajno, blog objave objavljene na mahove, konkurenti rangiraju više sa tanjim sadržajem

.comparison-right .comparison-text.en: Structured authority, semantic networks, predictable growth built on machine-readable truth
.comparison-right .comparison-text.bs: Strukturirani autoritet, semantičke mreže, predvidljiv rast izgrađen na mašinski čitivoj istini

#seo .positioning-text.en: Most SEO focuses on ranking pages. I focus on understanding why people search in the first place. The goal isn't traffic — the goal is becoming the safest decision in the customer's mind.
#seo .positioning-text.bs: Većina SEO-a fokusira se na rangiranje stranica. Ja se fokusiram na razumijevanje zašto ljudi uopšte pretražuju. Cilj nije saobraćaj — cilj je postati najsigurnija odluka u umu kupca.

#seo .positioning-subtext.en: I don't optimize websites for algorithms. I design search experiences that help both humans and machines arrive at the same conclusion: this is the right answer.
#seo .positioning-subtext.bs: Ne optimizujem web stranice za algoritme. Dizajniram iskustva pretrage koja pomažu i ljudima i mašinama da dođu do istog zaključka: ovo je tačan odgovor.

#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(1) .pillar-d.en: Understanding what triggers a search, what questions appear next, what creates trust, what creates doubt, and what makes users choose one brand over another
#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(1) .pillar-d.bs: Razumijevanje šta pokreće pretragu, koja pitanja se sljedeća pojavljuju, šta stvara povjerenje, šta stvara sumnju i šta navodi korisnike da izaberu jedan brend umjesto drugog

#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(2) .pillar-d.en: Designing topical maps, internal linking systems, knowledge hubs, and contextual pathways where every page has a purpose and every link has a reason
#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(2) .pillar-d.bs: Dizajniranje tematskih mapa, internih sistema linkovanja, hubova znanja i kontekstualnih puteva gdje svaka stranica ima svrhu a svaki link ima razlog

#seo-machine .ps-content.en: Every search has a visible layer (the query) and a hidden layer (the psychological reality). Traditional SEO optimizes for the query. I optimize for the reality.
#seo-machine .ps-content.bs: Svaka pretraga ima vidljivi sloj (upit) i skriveni sloj (psihološka realnost). Tradicionalni SEO optimizuje za upit. Ja optimizujem za realnost.

#seo-nothing-random .ps-content.en: In modern SEO, every word, link, heading, and URL is a deliberate signal. Search engines read your site like an analyst reads a document—they follow structure, verify facts, and remember consistency.
#seo-nothing-random .ps-content.bs: U modernom SEO-u, svaka riječ, link, naslov i URL je namjenski signal. Pretraživači čitaju vaš sajt kao analitičar čita dokument—prate strukturu, provjeravaju činjenice i pamte konzistentnost.

.reveal-content:nth-of-type(2).en: A person who agreed to a trail before knowing what "trail" meant, now fearing:
.reveal-content:nth-of-type(2).bs: Osoba koja se složila za stazu prije nego što je znala šta "staza" znači, sada se boji:

.exit-content.en: She bounces back to Google and types "do I really need hiking shoes for Zion"
.exit-content.bs: Vraća se na Google i kucá "zaista trebam li planinarske cipele za Zion"

.exit-insight.en: That's not a UX problem. That's an unresolved anomalous state of knowledge.
.exit-insight.bs: To nije UX problem. To je neriješeno anomalno stanje znanja.

.approach-wrong .approach-desc.bs: 140 proizvoda filtrirano po Gore-Texu i EVA đonovima

#capabilities .section-desc.en: A decade as a founder and multidisciplinary maker has forged a unique set of transferable skills. I don't just write code or design hardware; I solve complex problems from concept to market.
#capabilities .section-desc.bs: Decenija kao osnivač i multidisciplinarni kreator kovao je jedinstveni set prenosivih vještina. Ne samo pišem kod ili dizajniram hardver; rješavam složene probleme od koncepta do tržišta.

#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(1) .ca.en: Managed end-to-end product lifecycles for a decade. From napkin sketches to international distribution and manufacturing.
#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(1) .ca.bs: Upravljano cijelim životnim ciklusom proizvoda deceniju. Od skica na salištku do internacionalne distribucije i proizvodnje.

#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(2) .ca.en: Rapidly bridging the gap between hardware and software. Proficient in PCB design, firmware (C), and modern web stacks.
#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(2) .ca.bs: Brzo premošćivanje jaza između hardvera i softvera. Vešt u PCB dizajnu, firmware-u (C) i modernim web stackovima.

#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(3) .ca.en: Experienced in navigating complex supply chains across three countries, factory negotiations, and quality control.
#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(3) .ca.bs: Iskustvo u navigaciji složenih lanaca snabdijevanja kroz tri zemlje, pregovore sa fabrikama i kontrolu kvaliteta.
